items.headline: Escape Room entertainment venue permitted on Blossom Hill Rd
items.summary: A $949,000 permit was issued for an assembly-use commercial project at 925 Blossom Hill Rd for The Escape Room #1413, one of the larger commercial permits in this batch.

items.headline: Chagee tea shop cleared to build out Saratoga Ave space
items.summary: A $650,000 tenant improvement permit was issued for a Chagee restaurant space at 1600 Saratoga Avenue #201.
